subject: Cleanup: one superseded id-12 container-side check remains in SANDBOX_CHALLENGES['openstack-cli'] on bc1. Inert (the /check handler skips ids present in CLOUD_CHECKS) but it is a duplicate definition of a security-relevant check that could be accidentally re-enabled. Remove with an anchored edit (NOT a loose regex -- two prior attempts caused collateral: ids are per-lab not global, and CLOUD_CHECKS now also carries an 'openstack-cli' key).
